title: Hammam. Turkish
html_source: A Turkish bath or hammam (Turkish: hamam, Arabic: الحمام, ḥammām‎) is the Turkish variant of the Roman bath, steambath, sauna, or Russian banya, distinguished by a focus on water, as distinct from ambient steam.
